# Agent skills ship from the team harness

## Context

Each engineer kept their own copy of the work skills, and sessions behaved differently.

## Decision

Skills live in the team harness, are reviewed there, and every session loads the harness's copy.

## Consequences

A change to how agents work is a change to a harness skill, reviewed like code.
